name: Dext Prepare
pricing: From ~$25.21/mo annual (250 docs, 5 users); partner plans per client
summary: Capture, extract, and publish receipts and bills to Xero/QuickBooks (Dext Prepare / Dext Business).
useCase: Kill manual receipt entry for 50+ small clients.

name: Hubdoc
pricing: Included with qualifying Xero plans; standalone ~$12/mo
summary: Document fetch and OCR for Xero practices.
useCase: Auto-pull utility and bank statements monthly.

name: Booke AI
summary: AI bookkeeper inside QBO/Xero: daily categorization, OCR, exception review.
useCase: Reconcile uncategorized transactions and auto-chase clients.

name: Docyt
summary: AI-native accounting ERP for multi-location hospitality and retail, with continuous reconciliation and a closing agent.

name: Vic.ai
summary: Autonomous invoice processing and AP approvals.
useCase: Process high-volume AP for larger clients.

name: Digits
summary: AI-native general ledger with 24/7 bookkeeping and reconciliation; firms pay per client with no seat fees (US only).
useCase: Run an AI-first ledger for startup clients.

name: Karbon
summary: Practice management with AI email triage and summaries.
useCase: Triage client email and turn it into tasks.

name: Truewind
summary: AI-powered bookkeeping and close for startups and firms.

name: Botkeeper
summary: AI bookkeeping platform for firms (Infinite under Xendoo; operating again after Feb 2026 wind-down): categorization, close tracker, client hub.

name: ChatGPT (custom GPTs)
summary: General assistant used for client emails, memo drafts and spreadsheet analysis.
useCase: Draft plain-English month-end summaries for clients.

name: TaxDome
pricing: Essentials $800/seat/yr (solo only); Pro $1,000/seat/yr; Business $1,200/seat/yr (1-year terms, billed upfront)
summary: Practice management for tax and bookkeeping firms: CRM, client portal and app, workflows, billing, plus a Bookkeeping Hub that pulls uncategorized QuickBooks Online transactions for client review.
useCase: Run client portal, workflows and billing in one place, and send uncategorized QBO transactions to clients without a per-client fee.

name: Client Hub
pricing: Annual: Solopreneur $49/mo (solo only, all features); Practice Manager $59/user/mo; with QuickBooks and Xero integrations $79/user/mo. Monthly: $79 and $99/user/mo
summary: Practice management and client portal for bookkeeping firms: jobs, recurring workflows, email sync, client tasks and messaging, plus QuickBooks and Xero tools for uncategorized transactions and AI books review.
useCase: Turn client emails and requests into tracked tasks, and send uncategorized QBO or Xero transactions to clients inside the same portal.

name: Canopy
pricing: Annual billing: Standard $74, Plus $109, Premium $149 per user/mo; Enterprise custom. Add-ons: Close Automation $10 per connected client/mo (first 5 included), Tax Resolution $50/user/mo, Tax Workflow Automation from $34 per client credit
summary: All-in-one practice management for accounting firms: CRM, client portal, documents and eSign, workflows, time and billing, payments, plus an AI notetaker and a beta AI coworker that can carry out tasks with your permission.
useCase: Run client intake, document requests, recurring workflows and billing in one portal, and add AI month-end close checks that scan each client's ledger for issues.

name: Financial Cents
pricing: Solo $19/mo; Team $49/user/mo; Scale $69/user/mo (annual); Month-End Close add-on $5/client/mo
summary: Workflow and client-request tool for accounting firms, with a month-end close add-on for uncategorized transactions.
useCase: Track recurring bookkeeping deadlines and chase clients for missing docs and uncategorized transactions.

name: Double (formerly Keeper)
pricing: Per-client mix-and-match tiers (Core, Plus, Scale, Enterprise); prices not published; demo required to start
summary: Month-end close and client management layer on top of QuickBooks Online or Xero, with AI bank feeds and AI transaction review.
useCase: Review client files, flag uncategorized transactions, and get client answers before closing the month.

name: Uncat
pricing: $9/month per client (unlimited users, transactions and receipt matching); free trial
summary: Client portal for explaining uncategorized transactions and uploading receipts, syncing to and from QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop and Xero.
useCase: Send clients their uncategorized transactions, collect explanations and receipts, and sync answers back to the ledger before close.

name: Xenett
pricing: AI Financials Review $7.50/client/mo; Workflow $10/client/mo (USD); add-ons e.g. Accruals + AI $15/client/mo; 14-day free trial
summary: AI review of client P&L and Balance Sheet that flags account issues, plus firm workflow and close add-ons for accruals and inter-company reconciliation.
useCase: Scan every client file for P&L and Balance Sheet issues before review, then track close tasks across the firm.

name: BILL
pricing: AP & AR: Essentials $49, Team $65, Corporate $89 per user/mo; Accountant console $49/mo; ACH $0.59, check $1.99
summary: AP and AR automation with bill approvals, payments and 2-way accounting sync (Team and up); Accountant console manages multiple clients.
useCase: Run bill intake, approvals and vendor payments for many clients from one accountant console.

name: Ramp
pricing: Free $0/user/mo (cards, Bill Pay, QBO/Xero sync); Plus $15/user/mo + platform fee
summary: Corporate cards, expense management and Bill Pay with AI-assisted receipt matching and accounting rules for QuickBooks Online and Xero.
useCase: Move a client onto cards plus Bill Pay so receipts, coding and bill payments arrive in the ledger already matched.
